antithesis: My hypothesis is that 980nm photobiomodulation targeting citrate synthase in myocytes can reverse aging markers
synthesis: However, the 2025 study also warns that excessive irradiance decreases mitochondrial biogenesis
conclusion: Therefore we should use resonance water-lipid protocol at 306 THz pulsed at 10 femtoseconds for membrane repair for myocytes to maximize citrate synthase activation while minimizing thermal damage
